quotes.title: AU Microscopii
quotes.card: AU Microscopii is a young red dwarf star located 31.7 light-years away – about 8 times as far as the closest star after the Sun.
quotes.introduction: The apparent visual magnitude of AU Microscopii is 8.73, which is too dim to be seen with the naked eye.

notes: AU Mic d: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by transit timing variations)
AU Mic e: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
